categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp and has the P2P label, altering P2P message processing to defer BIP 157 filter requests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a protocol violation where Core fails to respond to BIP 157 requests for valid announced blocks, causing light clients like Neutrino to disconnect or ban Core nodes. As noted in issue #29655 and by reviewers, filter calculations race block announcements frequently enough that peers drop connections, making this an important interoperability and liveness fix.
